text:
Jade (Design): noticed confusion in the micro-tile dashboards

Microcharts feel cramped: legend text collides and unit labels get truncated. Thinking: collapse small legend to icon-only and surface full legend on hover. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Kofi (Frontend): icon-only is fine. we should keep accessible names so screen readers get the full legend. aria-hidden icons + visually-hidden labels works.
Priya (Data): for units, users expect consistent rounding across tiles. we should snap to human units (K/M) and not show decimals for tiles. full charts can keep exact.
Sasha (Product): agree. naming: toggle should say "Units: Auto | Raw" (Auto = humanized). previously "Exact" confused customers.
Jade (Design): +1 "Raw" is clearer. add tooltip copy: "Auto abbreviates (K/M); Raw shows integers." small and clear.
Omar (Eng): implementation constraints: small tiles use summarized series points (downsampled). if we snap ticks, we should do it based on tile max value to avoid showing 0.0K. I'll add a tick-snapping utility.
Priya (Data): another nit: smoothing. Data ops flagged monotone spline creating artificial troughs on sudden drop. Recommend default=linear for tiles, and "spline (soft)" as opt-in on detailed view.
Jade (Design): yes default linear for fidelity. For the opt-in spline, show an inline badge: "soften" and tooltip: "smooths small fluctuations, may alter peak values."
Kofi (Frontend): outlier policy: two conflicting asks: clamp y-axis vs show full range. we can default to clamp at 3x IQR and offer legend action to reveal true range. interaction proposal: legend > kebab menu > "Reveal outliers".
Sasha (Product): that interaction is good. copy: "Show full range (includes outliers)" to avoid surprise.
Omar (Eng): technical note: clamp can be computed server-side or client-side. client-side is faster for small tiles, server-side easier for consistency across pages. leaning client-side for initial rollout.
a11y-bot: a11y: compressed legends must keep keyboard focusable targets >= 44x44px, or provide expanded focus ring for smaller targets. hairline gridlines under 1px may fail contrast on low-DPI displays. ensure grid color meets 3:1 contrast vs bg.
Jade (Design): thanks. if we go subpixel for hairline, let's bump color to keep contrast. will add design token variants: grid-small and grid-large.
Kofi (Frontend): sample CSS for subpixel lines on canvas: ```js
ctx.translate(0.5,0.5); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,20,20,0.06)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();
```
works better than border hacks for pixel-alignment in canvas.
Priya (Data): on data fidelity: if we downsample for tiles, add a tooltip on hover: "Showing sampled preview. Open chart to see full dataset." avoids support confusion.
Sasha (Product): rollout plan: enable on dashboards only, keep embedded/legacy same for one release. run a 2-week AB test on readability/support mentions. track: average clicks to expand chart, and support tickets mentioning "missing spikes".
Omar (Eng): will add flags: feature.dashboard.microcharts=true, and include AB metrics. will open RFC with perf notes and server/client clamp discussion.
Jade (Design): will produce side-by-side mocks (small tile v1 and v2), include contrast swatches and annotation about smoothing and tick snap. mark as ready for design-qa when done. :white_check_mark:
